plan.rationale: Router authorized a merge of K5_C0001 and K5_C0005. The candidate-consensus structural diagnostics show a weak current boundary (normalized-cut 0.904, independent two-way spectral ARI ≈ 0.044) and a single-cluster-dominated union eigengap (candidate_k=1), consistent with the union being more coherent as one unit. Native-geometry concordance is conflicting (WSI separates; CT, RNA, WXS negligible), and the very small K5_C0005 side (4 samples) limits independent representation. Merge is the supported provisional revision and returns to normal review.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: The partition structural screen provides triage evidence on internal subdivision and boundary proximity. Every candidate set has its dominant spectral gap at k=1 (screen_candidate_k=1), with large leading eigengaps (0.73–0.96) and small secondary gaps, so the screening calculation does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any set. Within-set affinities (0.36–0.68) exceed all listed between-set affinities (0.11–0.15), and the nearest competing boundaries are K5_C0002–K5_C0003 and K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005–K5_C0002. This is partition-level structural evidence only; it does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity, and the absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: The partition structural screen provides triage evidence on internal subdivision and boundary proximity. Within-set affinities (0.36–0.68) exceed all listed between-set affinities (0.11–0.15), and the nearest competing boundaries are K5_C0002–K5_C0003 and K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005–K5_C0002.
